description: This Java class 'NullFeatures' represents a null or empty implementation of the 'Features' interface, providing methods to handle feature data in a JSON null context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: NullFeatures
classes.description: Immutable class representing a null or empty set of features, implementing the Features interface.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of NullFeatures.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional since no features exist.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with the provided feature.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Returns itself, as no features are present to remove.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets a feature definition, returns current instance.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes a feature definition, returns current instance.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a feature, returns current instance.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Removes properties for a feature, returns current instance.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value at a JSON pointer, returns current instance.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a property at a JSON pointer, returns current instance.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true indicating this is a null feature set.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of features.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON null object representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on class name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the class.
